product_metadata.title: FUNARTY Fake Plant Decor Small Artificial Hanging Plant Fake Eucalyptus Plant Faux Greenery Vine Plant in Pot for Home Indoor Room Outdoor Décor
features: 【Package includes】1 pack artificial hanging eucalyptus plant decor with black pot, artificial plant decor for home.
【Size】Each fake eucalyptus vine plant is appr. 3.5 " x 24.8 " and the pot is 3.5 " x 3.14 ".

【High Quality Material】Each artificial trailing plant is made of high quality plastic, these faux eucalyptus greenery are UV resistant and waterproof for realistic outdoors display. Fake eucalyptus vine plant in pot is nice and vivid for indoor and outdoor greenery decoration.

【No Maintenance Required】This small home decoration looks just like the real plant but require no trimming or watering and will stay fresh-looking all year round, which is good for patio plants, great artificial plant for home decor indoor. Specially, the root is fixed in the soil, which can’t be pulled out.

【Indoor and outdoor plants】Potted Fake hanging plants are suitable for desktop decoration, shelf decoration, bedroom decor, bathroom decoration, artificial eucalyptus garland vines are appropriate for living room, corridors, porches, cafes, stairs, outdoor garden house greenery decor and holidays like Halloween and Christmas.
